plugin.note: Rex is the melee Dagannoth King and is killed with Magic. It can be safespotted on the lair edges; use Protect from Melee during setup and tank Spinolyps with ranged defence and sustain.

requirements: Dagannoth task or Boss task where applicable for Slayer helmet bonuses
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock, a partner, or the 85 Agility shortcut to reach the Kings
75+ Magic recommended for Rex-only; higher stats and switches for tribrid
Antipoison or serpentine helm for Spinolyp poison
Elite Fremennik Diary strongly recommended for noted Dagannoth bones
mechanics: Dagannoth Rex uses melee and is weak to Magic.
Dagannoth Prime uses magic, can hit very hard, and must be answered with Protect from Magic while it is attacking.
Dagannoth Supreme uses ranged and is killed with Melee.
Spinolyps surround the island, use ranged and magic-based attacks, poison with ranged hits, and drain Prayer with magic hits.
The Kings should be killed in a cycle, safespotted, or fought outside each other's aggression range to reduce overlapping damage.
Rex can be lured to the north-eastern, south-eastern, or north-western walls and safely killed with Magic.
Prime can be reached from the northern or eastern edge with Ranged, but drops may require Telekinetic Grab if killed from range.
Supreme stands close to the other Kings and is the riskiest opener unless the player has high defence and strong melee gear.

methods.label: Kings overview
methods.summary: Use Magic for Rex, Ranged for Prime, and Melee for Supreme, with prayer swaps and positioning to avoid fighting multiple Kings longer than necessary.
recommendedFor: Dagannoth Slayer tasks used for boss profit
steps: Identify which Kings are aggressive after entering the lair.
Keep Protect from Magic active whenever Prime can attack.
Safespot Rex where possible and kill it with Magic.
Kill Prime with Ranged and Supreme with Melee when their aggression and respawn timing are controlled.
notes: The full page includes tribrid, Rex-only, and Prime-only strategies.

methods.label: Entering the lair
methods.summary: Enter with Protect from Magic active, then either set up a safespot or begin a controlled tribrid rotation.
steps: Activate Protect from Magic before climbing down because Prime is accurate and hits the hardest.
If safespotting Rex or Prime, enter and exit the room until the southern path to the eastern wall is safe from Prime and Supreme.
Run along the southern side to the eastern wall when neither Prime nor Supreme has targeted you.
Attack Rex with Magic from the eastern wall and move north or south to trap it on the wall.
For tribrid, start with Rex from the east wall, Prime from the north if Supreme is not aggressive, or Supreme only when Prime is not aggressive.
risks: Multiple Kings can target the player immediately after entering.
Starting on Supreme is usually the most difficult opener because it can draw the other Kings.

methods.label: Handling multicombat
methods.summary: Reduce overlap between Kings, off-tick prayers if skilled, or camp Protect from Magic while quickly killing Supreme or safespotting Rex.
steps: If multiple Kings attack, try to off-tick them and pray against the incoming style.
For a relaxed approach, keep Protect from Magic active because Prime is the highest immediate threat.
Kill Supreme quickly or move to safespot Rex to reduce the number of active attackers.
With very high defence and strong armour, use Protect from Magic and tank Rex/Supreme while killing them quickly.
risks: Incorrect prayer against Prime can result in very large damage.
Rex and Supreme become manageable with high defence but still drain supplies.

methods.label: Tribrid safe rotation
methods.summary: Start from the east wall, kill Rex with Magic, rotate north for Prime with Ranged, then south-west for Supreme with Melee.
steps: Enter without drawing aggression and move counter-clockwise along the southern wall to the east side.
Attack and safespot Rex with Magic along the east wall.
Rotate counter-clockwise north and attack Prime with Ranged from the northern wall.
Rotate counter-clockwise south and attack Supreme with Melee while staying west where possible.
Return to the eastern wall and safespot Rex again as the cycle repeats.
notes: Rex can be safespotted on the north-eastern, south-eastern, or north-western walls.
A long-range Ranged weapon can hit Prime from the northern side while outside Rex and Supreme aggression ranges.

methods.label: Tribrid fast rotation
methods.summary: Open aggressively with Supreme, then drag Rex into the north-west safespot and kill Prime from the north side.
steps: Enter and attack Supreme with Melee, avoiding Prime or praying correctly against its attacks.
Attack Rex with Magic while dragging it to the north-west safespot.
Move to the north side and attack Prime with Ranged.
Attack Supreme with Melee again while avoiding Rex by staying north or west.
Attack Rex with Magic and reuse the north-west safespot.
risks: This method assumes enough damage to kill Kings before their respawns overlap heavily.
Opening on Supreme can pull Prime or Rex if positioning is poor.

methods.label: Rex-only safespot
methods.summary: Safely lure Rex to an eastern-wall safespot and kill it with Magic for Berserker ring-focused trips.
requiredOrKeyItems: long-range magic spell or powered staff
steps: Reach the eastern wall without being targeted by Prime or Supreme.
Attack Rex with a long-range Magic spell or staff.
Pray Protect from Melee as Rex approaches the eastern wall.
Move north or south until Rex is stuck on the wall and cannot reach the player.
Kill Rex with Magic while tanking Spinolyps.
Use blood spells, Guthan's, regen bracelet, Hitpoints cape, Saradomin godsword, or Sanguinesti staff for sustain.
risks: Other players can intentionally or accidentally drag Prime's area attack onto a Rex safespotter.
Spinolyps become the main supply drain in the safe area.

methods.label: Prime only
methods.summary: Range Prime from the north-east/eastern side while staying outside Rex and Supreme aggression.
recommendedFor: Alternating Rex and Prime from safe positions
steps: Set up near the north-east/eastern side of the room.
Attack Prime with Ranged while staying outside Supreme and Rex aggression range.
Use Telekinetic Grab if drops cannot be collected safely.
Alternate between Rex and Prime if desired.
risks: Prime does not walk toward the player, so looting can require waiting for a safe timing or using Telekinetic Grab.

methods.label: Max tribrid inventory
methods.summary: High-end tribrid inventory with switches, Saradomin godsword, Death Charge, boost potions, antipoison/restores, emergency healing, route items, and herb sack.
inventory: Araxyte venom sacks, Sanfew serums, or antipoison coverage
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless using the shortcut
notes: The page recommends completing the full Slayer task in one trip or as few trips as possible.

methods.label: Mid-level tribrid inventory
methods.summary: Mid-level tribrid uses fewer switches, Blood/Ice spell utility, standard combat boosts, restores, emergency food, route items, and herb sack.
inventory: Melee, Ranged, and Magic weapon switches
Rune pouch for Blood spells and optional Ice spells
Araxyte venom sacks, Sanfew serums, or antipoison coverage
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless using the shortcut

methods.label: Rex safespot inventory
methods.summary: Rex-only inventory prioritises magic weaponry, antipoison, prayer potions, food, teleport, route items, and optional Guthan's sustain.
inventory: Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless using the shortcut
Rune pouch for Blood spells and optional Ice spells
Food such as sharks or better

methods.label: Early Ironman Rex inventory
methods.summary: Early Rex setup uses Iban's staff, tank gear, antipoison, a few prayer potions, emergency teleport, route items, and high-healing food.
inventory: Iban's staff or equivalent spell setup
Rune thrownaxe and pet rock unless using the shortcut
Runes for chosen spells such as Blood spells, Iban Blast, or High Alchemy

methods.label: Tips and tricks
methods.summary: Travel, sustain, poison, boost, cannon, and shortcut optimisations for longer Dagannoth Kings trips.
notes: Use a dwarf multicannon with 1,000-2,000 cannonballs on Prime's spawn to smooth tribrid rotations; only load it when Prime spawns.
Attune a player-owned house portal to Waterbirth to reduce travel time.
Use Saradomin brews and super restores, or sharks with emergency brews for simpler trips.
Guthan's set and Saradomin godsword can reduce food use.
Ancient Magicks can help: Ice Barrage freezes Rex and Blood spells heal.
Bring antipoison unless wearing serpentine helm; Sanfew serum doubles as antipoison and restore.
Peek from the safe spot east of the Dagannoth Kings ladder to check whether the arena is occupied.
Elite Fremennik Diary notes Dagannoth bones and substantially improves profit.
Explorer's ring can replace a stamina potion for high alchemy utility.
High melee stats on task can justify using a godsword as both special weapon and Supreme weapon.
Menaphite remedy with divine boosts can save inventory space.
The 85 Agility shortcut, or 80 Agility with Summer pie, skips rune thrownaxe and pet rock.

styleOptions.label: Tribrid solo
styleOptions.summary: Use Magic, Ranged, and Melee to kill all three Kings, balancing damage, ranged defence, prayer bonus, and supplies.

styleOptions.label: Magic Rex only
styleOptions.summary: Rex-only setup uses Magic with tanky ranged-defence gear; full melee armour can still hit Rex reliably because its Magic defence is very low.

styleOptions.label: Ranged Prime only
styleOptions.summary: Prime-only setup maximises ranged strength and accuracy, with optional tank switches or healing gear while waiting for respawns.

# Dagannoth Rex

Full Dagannoth Kings strategy source with entering, multicombat handling, tribrid rotations, Rex-only safespot, Prime-only, inventories, and trip optimisations. Rex itself is killed with Magic.
